summary: Super League Enterprise filed an 8-K reporting a Redemption Agreement with the sole holder of its Series C Senior Convertible Preferred Stock. The company paid a one-time cash consideration of $922,400 to redeem and cancel all 1,153 outstanding shares of preferred stock, and terminate an associated Equity Purchase Agreement dated July 10, 2025, including releases of claims. The payment was made on June 8, 2026. No early termination penalties were incurred. This is a capital return event where the issuer redeems preferred equity, reducing leverage and potential dilution. Watch for any subsequent financing or capital structure changes.
